items.title: Guide: start the Hell event and beat its demon boss
items.summary: Polygon's guide shows how to trigger the Hell event by meeting Dave and Beelzebub at their garage on the north side of Port Hellhorn after starting Chapter 2 and visiting after 10 p.m., riding the van to a campfire ritual that sends you to Hell, then making the final boss vulnerable by destroying its exploding headless demons to earn the Hellspawn Comshot, a Circles of Hell top and tattoo, and a permanent max health upgrade.

items.title: Guide: find the Fast & Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse on Vespucci Island
items.summary: Polygon's guide shows where to steal Brian O'Conner's green Eclipse, in-game as the '97 Maibatsu Penumbra FF, from a gated house on Vespucci Island in Vice-Dale County: break in beside the garage before the alarm, use the slim jim if you've met Moses, then pay $6,750 to register the fast coupe or sell it for $1,100.

items.title: Players find a tow-truck trick to rip ATMs out of walls for cash
items.summary: Polygon reports players are discovering new ways to get rich, including a Reddit find that a tow truck's hook can yank an outdoor ATM clean out of a building wall, drag it to a safe spot and smash it open for the cash inside, alongside opportunistic loot from crashed robbery scenes.

items.title: A no-kill GTA VI run fails within two hours
items.summary: Polygon's attempt to play GTA VI without killing anyone ends barely two hours in: after sparing foes with fists and leg shots that incapacitate instead of kill, accidental roadkills in the impound lot and a knife picked up mid-brawl log the first kill, and the 'Hey, Arnold' chase adds more despite sparing Arnold himself.

items.title: Guide: find the giant crab and win the Crabshack VF5 SMG
items.summary: Polygon's guide walks through the optional Pelican Valley Outpost event, where the giant crab Karkinos guards a research compound: restore power, log in with the password CLEAVES, crack the safe with code 0072, then use the emergency code 0212 to open the boathouse and claim the crab-themed Crabshack VF5 SMG.

items.title: GTA VI's launch barely dents Steam and Roblox player counts
items.summary: Polygon reports Game File tracking found Steam peaked at 11.4 million players on November 20, barely down from 11.7 million the week before, while Roblox drew 9.6 million players on launch day versus 9.7 million a week earlier, suggesting the console-only launch left rival platforms largely untouched.

items.title: An unreleased D'Angelo song is hiding on GTA VI's radio
items.summary: Polygon reports players have found the late D'Angelo's unreleased track 'Kamikazi' playing on Worldwide FM, with another song, 'Lady,' on Honey FM — a posthumous nod to the Red Dead Redemption 2 collaborator who died in October 2025, confirmed by his collaborator DJ Dojah via Rolling Stone.

items.title: GTA VI: The Festival takes over Miami tonight with Travis Scott and Cardi B
items.summary: GGRecon runs through Rockstar's set times for tonight's one-night festival at Mana Wynwood in Miami: doors at 4 p.m. ET across two stages, Cardi B at 7:45, a Justice DJ set at 9, Metro Boomin at midnight and a Cactus Jack closing set led by Travis Scott at 12:40 a.m., with ticket proceeds going to local Miami charities and no official livestream announced.

items.title: GTA VI: The Album is out now with 34 original tracks
items.summary: Hypebeast reports Atlantic Records and Rockstar have released the full 34-track companion album on streaming, spanning Playboi Carti, Dua Lipa, JENNIE, Travis Scott and even Keith Richards, with three Atlantic-exclusive physical editions including a liquid-filled vinyl, a splatter vinyl and a CD jewel case.

items.title: Players find infinite-money tricks in GTA VI — and many are refusing to use them
items.summary: Polygon rounds up the get-rich-quick methods going viral, from looting a South Vice-Dale County warehouse and save-reloading to respawn its roughly $8,000 haul, to a mission-restart trick that instantly reopens robbed stores, and notes many players are swearing off the exploits because they undercut the game's scrape-by story, with a Rockstar patch likely to close them.

items.title: A camera glitch unlocks a hidden first-person mode in GTA VI
items.summary: VGC's guide explains how remapping the touch pad or View button to Camera, then opening and closing the in-game phone inside a car while mashing that shortcut, locks the view into a surprisingly complete first-person mode with working weapon animations, though shop menus can break it and only reloading a save returns to third-person.

items.title: 61% of US PS5 players played GTA VI on launch day, averaging over 8 hours
items.summary: Polygon reports Circana analyst Mat Piscatella shared launch-day data showing 61% of US PlayStation 5 players and 56% of global Xbox players played GTA VI on November 19, averaging 513 minutes on PS5 and 494 minutes on Xbox, figures he called 'absolutely bonkers', with Fortnite a distant second at 10%.

items.title: 'Florida Joker' Lawrence Sullivan turns up in GTA VI's credits
items.summary: GTA BOOM notes the man who accused Rockstar of copying his likeness in the first trailer and demanded $10 million is listed in the game's credits under 'The Local Population' for background work, a far more modest credit than the lead voice role he claims in a viral reaction video.

items.title: Critics give 99, players give 5.4: GTA VI gets review-bombed on Metacritic
items.summary: Push Square reports Metacritic user reviews opened to a 5.4 'Mixed or Average' score driven by a wave of zero ratings citing 30fps and the story, a sharp split from the critics' 99 average, while the PlayStation Store rating, which requires a purchase, sits at 4.84 from about 170,000 reviews.

items.title: GTA VI preloads give Comcast its busiest traffic day ever
items.summary: IGN reports Comcast says November 18 pre-loads made it the busiest day in the company's history, with peak traffic 31% above an average day and 9.6% above the previous record, GTA VI making up 24% of peak traffic and accounting for five of its ten busiest days ever.
